parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container of the number field. It holds the numeric state, the format, and the validation, and it gives the context to all of the parts. With a `name`, it also makes a hidden input that submits the raw number.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: value
props.description: The numeric value. You can bind it. It is always a raw number, and the component makes the text separately.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the numeric value changes.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: The `Intl.NumberFormat` options that make the text in the input: the currency, the percent, the unit, and the number of the decimals.

props.name: min
props.description: The smallest value that the field accepts.

props.name: max
props.description: The largest value that the field accepts.

props.name: step
props.description: The change from the arrow keys, the step buttons, the mouse wheel, and the pointer drag. With `'any'`, the change is 1 and the component does not validate against the step.

props.name: smallStep
props.description: The change from the arrow keys while the user holds `Ctrl` or `Cmd`.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The change from the arrow keys while the user holds `Shift`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the interaction with the field and removes it from the focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the input focusable, but stops the changes of the value.

props.name: required
props.description: Makes the input required for the form validation.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as not valid. The component sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Replaces the `aria-invalid` value that the component calculates.

props.name: allowWheelScrub
props.description: Lets the mouse wheel change the value while the input has the focus.

props.name: allowOutOfRange
props.description: Lets the field accept a value that the user types below `min` or above `max`. With `false`, the user can still edit that value while the input has the focus. When the input loses the focus, the value goes to `min` or to `max`.

props.name: snapOnStep
props.description: Moves a stepped value to the nearest multiple of `step`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the hidden input that submits the raw number with a form.

props.name: incrementAriaLabel
props.description: Replaces the localized accessible name of the increment button.

props.name: decrementAriaLabel
props.description: Replaces the localized accessible name of the decrement button.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while any part of the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-hidden-input
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden native input for the form submission.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the user drags the value with a pointer.

parts.name: Group
parts.description: Contains the controls that the user sees: the input and the step buttons. It shows the state of the field in data attributes.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while any part of the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-group
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the user drags the value with a pointer.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: The text input that the user sees, with role="spinbutton". It controls the text with its format, the keyboard steps, and the native validity.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-input-state
dataAttributes.description: The relation between the text in the input and the value: "synced", "partial", "invalid", or "out-of-range".

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-input
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-out-of-range
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is less than `min` or more than `max`.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the user drags the value with a pointer.

parts.name: Increment
parts.description: The button that makes the value larger by `step`. It is not in the tab order, and it has a localized default name.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button, usually an icon or a symbol.

parts.name: Decrement
parts.description: The button that makes the value smaller by `step`. It is not in the tab order, and it has a localized default name.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button, usually an icon or a symbol.

parts.name: ScrubArea
parts.description: Makes its content into a drag control. While the user drags the pointer, the value changes.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the drag area, for example a name and a `NumberField.ScrubAreaCursor`.

props.name: direction
props.description: The axis of the pointer movement that changes the value.

props.name: pixelSensitivity
props.description: The pointer movement for one step, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-direction
dataAttributes.description: The configured scrub direction ("horizontal" or "vertical").

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-scrub-area
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the scrub area element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the user drags the value with a pointer.

parts.name: ScrubAreaCursor
parts.description: An optional cursor, in the DOM while the user drags. It follows the pointer in the drag area.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the cursor.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-scrub-area-cursor
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the scrub area cursor element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while the user drags the value with a pointer.
